Which test results show that a sample of water is pure?
1
Its boiling point is 100°C.
2
Its freezing point is 0°C.
3
It turns anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride from blue to pink.
4
It turns anhydrous copper(II) sulfate from white to blue.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
